name: sensei_field_access_on_custom_type
description: Field access on a custom type record unwraps _type/_value transparently
input:
type Greeting
  message: Text
  count: Number

pure make_greeting
  needs name: Text
  gives Greeting
  do
    give Greeting(message: "hello {name}", count: 1)

fn main
  g = make_greeting("world")
  say g.message
  say "{g.count}"
